::: {#exm-roster-notation}
#### Order and repetition do not matter

The sets $\set{3, 1, 2}$, $\set{1, 2, 3}$ and $\set{1, 1, 2, 3, 3}$ are equal,
because each has exactly the elements $1$, $2$ and $3$ (@def-set).
A roster can list any objects, not only numbers:
$\set{\text{red}, \text{green}, \text{blue}}$ is a set with three elements.

:::
